app.commerce-import.title: Commerce Import
app.commerce-import.adminApi.disabled: The Shopify Admin API is not configured. The full import cannot run until it is set up in Commerce settings.
app.commerce-import.adminApi.required: Configure the Shopify Admin API first.
app.commerce-import.backfill.inventoryHi: Inventory imports a full snapshot (no date range). It also refreshes the stock locations first, so the reorder review's destination locations are populated.
app.commerce-import.backfill.rangeHint: Leave both dates empty to import the entire history.
app.commerce-import.backfill.note: Backfill imports historical records into the CMS mirror only — it does not start the review workflow. Re-running is safe.
app.commerce-import.backfill.ordersChain: An orders backfill also fetches the refunds of the imported orders (refund-bearing orders only), then seeds the sales facts automatically — no separate runs needed.
app.commerce-import.backfill.invalidRang: The From date must be on or before the To date.
app.commerce-import.salesSeed.note: Runs automatically after an orders backfill completes. The seed only queues — the single-writer drainer materializes the facts, and Remaining drains to 0.
